# Numeric save checkpoints

These recipes cover the active-bomb yard office in English CD 1.00.12 and
DVD 2.05.00. Reconstruct with your matching original database and executable
using the [build guide](../../../docs/building.md#native-game-checks).

Use `bomb-office-*` for death/retry and `story-office-*` for inventory and save/load.
The latter extends the same checkpoint's bomb timer to three minutes.
Saved pictures and changed text are omitted. Keep reconstructed saves outside Git.

`disc-01-*` through `disc-07-*` provide starting points for English CD 1.00.12
and DVD 2.05.00.
Discs 2–7 are based on the TotalGames checkpoints. They cover the Field Office,
Comity Inn, apartment, hospital and Rauch House. These numeric fixtures omit
photos, changed text and transient packed state.
At the hospital, use a navigation arrow before quick-saving.
